name: DigiTools
description: An AI tool subscription platform designed to improve productivity, creativity, and access to modern AI services.
longDescription: DigiTools presents modern AI services through a clear, subscription-focused experience. The interface is designed for fast discovery, readable product information, and a smooth journey across mobile and desktop devices.

name: MediQueue
description: A modern Tutor Booking web application where students can explore tutors, book learning sessions, and manage scheduled classes efficiently.
longDescription: MediQueue is a full-stack Tutor Booking platform designed to simplify tutor discovery, session scheduling, and booking management. Students can browse available tutors, search by name, filter tutors by session date, view tutor details, and book learning sessions based on real-time slot availability. The platform includes secure authentication, JWT-protected routes, tutor CRUD operations, booking restrictions, responsive design, dark and light themes, smooth animations, and toast notifications.

name: Bank Loan Calculator
description: A financial platform where users can explore loan options, calculate payments, and plan repayments.
longDescription: A practical financial calculator that converts loan amount, interest rate, and repayment term into clear monthly payment estimates. Interactive controls make it easy to compare values and understand repayment planning.

name: Tile Gallery
description: A modern tile storefront that makes browsing products and discovering interior design options simple.
longDescription: Tile Gallery is a product discovery experience for browsing tile collections, viewing product information, and organizing favorites. Its clean storefront structure is optimized for product clarity and responsive browsing.
